result.description: Fictional compact mechanical keyboard with split ortholinear layout, hot-swappable switches, per-key RGB lighting, and a detachable braided USB-C cable. Designed for writing, coding, and tabletop command stations rather than storage or media transport. Aluminum top plate, gasket mount, and onboard macro profiles for up to five user modes.
